about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Sport TDV6 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover Sport TDV6 has been a key part of the model line-up since 2005, spanning two generations of the vehicle. The earlier L320 generation (2005–2013) and the later L494 (2013–2022) both use the 3.0-litre V6 diesel engine, offered in both TDV6 and SDV6 forms. The SDV6 is a higher-output variant of the same engine family, but both share the same core architecture and known wear patterns. Knowing which one your car has matters for exact parts matching, which is why we confirm your exact engine by registration before quoting.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace TDV6 & SDV6 engines for every Range Rover Sport TDV6 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre V6 diesel fitted to the Range Rover Sport from 2005 to 2022 across two generations. Known for timing chain tensioner wear, injector seal leaks, and crankshaft bearing wear over time — see the callout above. We replace timing chains, tensioners, injector seals, and gaskets as standard on every TDV6 rebuild.
cards.cta: Check Your TDV6 Range Rover Sport TDV6

cards.body: A higher-output version of the same 3.0-litre V6 diesel, also fitted from 2005 to 2022. Shares the same known issues as the TDV6, including timing chain tensioner wear and injector seal leaks. We apply the same component replacement as standard on every SDV6 rebuild.

compatibility.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover Sport TDV6 ENGINE
compatibility.intro: Because the TDV6 and SDV6 are variants of the same engine family, fitting the correct replacement or ensuring the right parts are used is critical. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (TDV6 & SDV6) via registration or VIN
Whether your build falls in the early production period (2019-2020) for injector fault coverage

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Defender quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
